queries.name: Department Salary & Headcount
queries.description: Aggregates total employee count, annual salary sum, and average salary grouped by department. (Verified warehouse.dbo)
queries.query_text:
SELECT 
    department,
    COUNT(*) AS total_employees,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    ROUND(SUM(salary), 2) AS total_payroll
FROM warehouse.dbo.silver_employees
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

queries.name: NYSE Top Market Cap Tickers by Sector
queries.description: Ranks top publicly traded companies on NYSE by sector and calculates market capitalization totals.
queries.query_text:
SELECT 
    sector,
    COUNT(ticker) AS num_companies,
    ROUND(SUM(market_cap_b), 2) AS total_market_cap_b,
    ROUND(AVG(market_cap_b), 2) AS avg_market_cap_b
FROM warehouse.dbo.nyse_tickers
GROUP BY sector
ORDER BY total_market_cap_b DESC;

queries.name: Product Inventory Valuation & Low Stock Warning
queries.description: Computes total inventory asset value per category and highlights SKUs requiring immediate reordering.
queries.query_text:
SELECT 
    category,
    product_name,
    stock_qty,
    price,
    ROUND(stock_qty * price, 2) AS inventory_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN stock_qty < 25 THEN 'CRITICAL: Reorder Now'
        WHEN stock_qty < 50 THEN 'WARNING: Low Stock'
        ELSE 'HEALTHY'
    END AS stock_health
FROM warehouse.dbo.dim_products
ORDER BY stock_qty ASC;

queries.name: Gold Telemetry Hourly KPI Trends
queries.description: Analyzes device sensor metrics, average temperatures, and event volumes from the Gold analytical layer.
queries.query_text:
SELECT 
    device_id,
    ROUND(avg_temp, 2) AS avg_temperature,
    event_count,
    window_start
FROM warehouse.dbo.gold_telemetry_kpis
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 50;
